messages:
Acme Ops: Hey team — since yesterday afternoon we started seeing p95 jump from ~350ms to 1.2s for our /v1/generate route during bursts. Also intermittent 504s. Can we collect what you need to reproduce?
Emma (Support): Sorry you're hitting this — we can help collect a repro pack. Can you share a few failing request IDs and a HAR or curl for one failing call? Also which model + seq lengths?
Acme Ops: Sending sample request IDs: req_9f8a1, req_a3c2b, req_b07ee. Model is redwood-large, typical prompt mean tokens ~220, tails up to 2.5k. Will attach HAR in a follow up.
Maria (CE): Thanks — please redact API keys before upload. For HARs we need at least 10 samples spanning success and failure windows, plus a concurrency profile (how many concurrent clients and average RPS). If possible include one curl that reproduces the 504.
Acme Ops: Uploaded har_bundle_1950012400.har to the drop link. One curl we used (redacted):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<trimmed prompt>","max_tokens":512}' 
```
Emma (Support): Perfect. Can you also run a capture with the request ID header enabled so our tracing links match logs? e.g. add `X-Request-ID: <your-id>` to the curl and paste the header value. That helps us correlate runtime traces and KV cache hits.
Acme Ops: Will do. For the failing one, X-Request-ID: xreq-1950012377.
Raj (SRE): Quick ask from infra — please include a short concurrency matrix: list of (clients, concurrency, RPS, avg prompt tokens) for 5-minute windows around the spike. Also, can you confirm whether you had caching enabled (prefix or kv caching) and whether clients were sending the same conversation_id?
Acme Ops: Concurrency matrix: 10 clients @ 30 concurrency (burst), avg RPS 120, avg tokens 220. Cache: none. Conversation_id varied per user.
Maria (CE): Since token tails hit 2.5k, we should also capture a sample with `max_tokens` forced to 128 to see p50/p95 impact. Can you produce two curl variants: one short (128) and one long (2048) and include both in the bundle?
Acme Ops: Done. Uploaded two example curls: curl_short.txt and curl_long.txt. Included output tokens counts and response headers.
Raj (SRE): We'll need host metrics — GPU utilization, process-level CPU, and network stats for the time window. If you're on Dedicated/Private, please run `redwoodctl debug-collect --since 2025-06-01T14:00Z --until 2025-06-01T16:00Z` and upload the tarball. If on Hosted, attach HAR + request ids and we'll pull infra traces.
Acme Ops: We're on Dedicated. Running redwoodctl now — ETA 10m.
Emma (Support): Also helpful: a small vegeta attack spec or load plan that mirrors your client concurrency so we can reproduce locally if needed. Example snippet we often use: 
```
echo 'POST http://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate
Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>
Content-Type: application/json

{"model":"redwood-large","input":"<trimmed prompt>","max_tokens":512}' > target.json
vegeta attack -targets=target.json -rate=200 -connections=40 -duration=1m | vegeta report
```
Maria (CE): Note for reproducing latency regressions: include stepwise ramps (5m @ 50RPS, 10m @ 200RPS burst, 5m cooldown) and vary prompt lengths. That often surfaces batching and KV cache warmup behavior.
Acme Ops: Upload complete: redwood_debug_bundle_1950012500.tar.gz (includes redwoodctl output, system metrics, veg_spec.json, HARs, curl_short/long, request-id list). Link shared.
deploy-bot: Deployed redwood-runtime v3.8.2 to us-west-2 at 2025-06-01T15:02:10Z by ops-ci (sha: a1b2c3).
Raj (SRE): Good note — we saw a runtime deploy during the window from deploy-bot; tagging that in the investigation. We'll correlate the bundle with deploy timing.
Emma (Support): I'll open an internal case and paste the bundle link + request ids. Expect initial triage in 2 hours. If you can run a short vegeta playback while we triage that'd be useful.
Acme Ops: Running a 5m playback now (using the veg_spec we uploaded). Will post results after.
Maria (CE): If the vegeta run reproduces p95, capture one failing request's full raw response headers/body and paste the request-id — that'll help us determine whether it's a model timeout, runtime queueing, or upstream timeout at the edge.
Acme Ops: After replay: p50 stayed ~360ms, p95 ~1.15s, 4xx/5xx rate rose to 0.8% during the 10-15s bursts. Uploaded vegeta_results.json and a sample failing response with id xreq-1950012689.
Raj (SRE): Thanks — assigning to infra to fetch GPU and queue length at xreq-1950012689 window. Also checking for kernel OOMs and slow disk IO from logging.
Emma (Support): We'll keep you posted here; thanks for the quick bundle. If anything else pops up, ping me or open a new thread but keep this request group so we have all artifacts together. :thumbsup:
Acme Ops: Thanks all — appreciate the rapid help.
